regions.name: Alakol
regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own 2012 painting of Alakol, restored: the 2012 Encyclopedia showed it under the game’s roads, names and buttons, and that picture was given to an image model to take the markings off and sharpen without moving anything, then toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: The cleanest of the first four: cliffs, the rock ridge, the clouds, the beach and the huts sit where 2012 had them. The model returned it a little greener and more saturated; the toning step brings it back to 2012's colour.
